title: My Response to Satya Sadhu's Hate Speech
description:
A viral clip of Satya Sadhu mocking a Christian priest has been circulating on social media, where he ridicules the idea of virgin birth using “biology” and “science.”
In this video, I respond to that hate speech by applying the same  standard across all religions from an atheistic perspective.

From virgin births in Christianity, to mantra pregnancies and jar babies in Hindu scriptures, to miracles in Islamic tradition, this video exposes the double standard where people demand logic only from other faiths while suspending it for their own.

This is not an attack on any one religion.
It is a critique of selective skepticism, intellectual dishonesty, and how mockery replaces reason.

If you’ve searched for Satya Sadhu hate speech, virgin birth debate, religion vs science, double standards in religion, Hindu miracles explained, Christian miracles questioned, Islamic miracles criticism, atheist response to religious hate, this video gives you the rational perspective.
Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share.

00:00 – A New Scientific Genius Appears
Dry intro to Satya Sadhu and the viral church incident

01:18 – When Questioning Miracles Is Suddenly “Science”
Selective biology and convenient skepticism

03:05 – Mahabharata: Did Anyone Give Birth Normally?
Mantra babies, jar babies, fire births, and evolutionary amnesia

05:42 – Christianity & Islam Are Not Exempt
Virgin births, angels, flying prophets, and suspended physics

08:04 – Why Every Believer Thinks They’re the Exception
Psychology of familiarity, belief, and bias

10:05 – Science or Team Loyalty? Pick One
Consistency test across all religions

11:32 – The Thought That Actually Hurts
Final unsettling reflection on belief and upbringing
